name: onTheHammock AEO&SEO Optimizer
author: onthehammock

sections.description:
onTheHammock AEO&SEO Optimizer is a comprehensive optimization plugin for WordPress that covers AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and traditional SEO.

As AI-powered search engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.) become the primary way people find information, traditional SEO alone is no longer enough. onTheHammock AEO&SEO Optimizer helps your content get discovered and cited by AI search engines.

Free Features

  • SEO meta tags (Title / Description / Canonical)
  • SNS optimization (OGP / Twitter Card)
  • Structured data (JSON-LD / Schema.org — FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, WebSite)
  • XML Sitemap (sitemap.xml)
  • Breadcrumbs
  • Auto-inject article summary and FAQ into post content
  • AEO Score for each post and site

Four Pillars of AEO Optimization

  • Answer First — Place the conclusion at the top so AI can extract it instantly
  • Originality & Primary Sources — Unique data and experiences AI can reference
  • Structure & Readability — Bullet points and numeric data for better AI parsing
  • Trustworthiness (E-E-A-T) — Author expertise and information freshness signals

Conflict Detection

Automatically detects Yoast SEO, RankMath, All in One SEO, SEOPress, and The SEO Framework. When a conflict is detected, onTheHammock AEO&SEO Optimizer disables overlapping output (title, meta description, OGP) and focuses on FAQPage structured data and content injection only.

⚡ Pro Version Available

onTheHammock AEO&SEO Optimizer Pro adds AI-powered automation on top of all free features.

Pro features ($29/year):

  • AI Auto-Fill — AI reads your site and post content and auto-fills all 8 AEO fields. Supports Groq (free tier), OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral.
  • AEO Score — 8-factor evaluation of how AI-friendly your content is, with real-time feedback per article.
  • Site-wide AEO Profile — Generate a complete AEO profile for your entire site with one click.
  • Custom Template Reading — Reads content from custom PHP page templates.
  • FAQ Auto-Generation — Automatically generates FAQ content from your site’s existing content.
  • SEO & OGP Preview — Live preview of how your content appears in search results and social shares.
  • Gutenberg Sidebar Panel — AEO settings directly in the block editor sidebar.

👉 Download Pro & purchase license: https://onthehammock.com/aeoplugin/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/onthehammock-aeo-seo-optimizer/, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to AEO&SEO Optimizer in the admin sidebar.
  4. Enable or disable features in the Enable / Disable Features section.
  5. Fill in the AEO Settings fields for your site.
  6. Optionally, purchase a Pro license to unlock AI-powered auto-fill at https://onthehammock.com/aeoplugin/
sections.faq:
Do I need a license to use this plugin?

No. All core features — SEO meta tags, OGP, structured data, XML sitemap, breadcrumbs, and content injection — are completely free. A license is required only for the AI-powered auto-fill feature available in the Pro version.

Where can I get the Pro version?

Visit https://onthehammock.com/aeoplugin/ to learn about Pro features and purchase a license ($29/year).

Will this plugin conflict with Yoast SEO or RankMath?

onTheHammock AEO&SEO Optimizer automatically detects other SEO plugins and disables overlapping features. FAQPage structured data and content injection continue to work alongside other SEO plugins.

Is this plugin compatible with the block editor (Gutenberg)?

Yes. The AEO meta box appears in both the classic editor and the block editor.

What data does this plugin send externally?

The free version does not send data to external AI providers. Only the Pro version uses external AI provider APIs when AI auto-fill is enabled.
